window.first_order_directional_law: relative quadrupole/dipole bias ~ z; usable only if z * (true amplitude) << formal statistical sd (0.5-1% of Hbar for Q with Pantheon+ cuts), i.e. z <~ 0.05-0.1 for amplitudes of a few percent; the monopole needs free z-dependence at every z
window.second_order_with_declared_nuisance: d_L = (z/H(n))[1 + c0(n) z]; c0 H^2 is a degree<=4 polynomial in n (l=0,2,4) => free l<=4 nuisance; remaining error ~0.12 z^2 (0.9% at z=0.3)
window.caveat: numbers are for one anisotropic power-law family; other histories (tilt, non-flat Bianchi types, rotation) are not covered
